/v1/internal/billing/admissions/{admission_id}/capture:
    post:
      operationId: captureAdmission
      x-kokoro-owner: kokoro-billing
      x-kokoro-visibility: internal-owner
      x-kokoro-stability: experimental
      x-kokoro-idempotency: required
      x-kokoro-permission: agent-model-studio-service
      security:
        - tenantContext: []
          serviceCaller: []
          internalSecret: []
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/TenantId"
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey"
        - name: admission_id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/Uuid"
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/AdmissionCaptureRequest"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Success
          headers:
            x-request-id:
              $ref: "#/components/headers/RequestId"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/AdmissionResponse"
        "400":
          description: Request failed
          headers:
            x-request-id:
              $ref: "#/components/headers/RequestId"
          x-kokoro-errors:
            - code: billing.invalid_request
              retryable: false
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
        "401":
          description: Authentication required
          headers:
            x-request-id:
              $ref: "#/components/headers/RequestId"
          x-kokoro-errors:
            - code: billing.unauthenticated
              retryable: false
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
        "403":
          description: Forbidden
          headers:
            x-request-id:
              $ref: "#/components/headers/RequestId"
          x-kokoro-errors:
            - code: billing.forbidden
              retryable: false
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
        "404":
          description: Not found
          headers:
            x-request-id:
              $ref: "#/components/headers/RequestId"
          x-kokoro-errors:
            - code: billing.not_found
              retryable: false
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
        "409":
          description: Conflict
          headers:
            x-request-id:
              $ref: "#/components/headers/RequestId"
          x-kokoro-errors:
            - code: billing.idempotency_conflict
              retryable: false
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
        "422":
          description: Invalid state
          headers:
            x-request-id:
              $ref: "#/components/headers/RequestId"
          x-kokoro-errors:
            - code: billing.invalid_state
              retryable: false
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
        "500":
          description: Internal failure
          headers:
            x-request-id:
              $ref: "#/components/headers/RequestId"
          x-kokoro-errors:
            - code: billing.internal_error
              retryable: false
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
        "503":
          description: Dependency unavailable
          headers:
            x-request-id:
              $ref: "#/components/headers/RequestId"
          x-kokoro-errors:
            - code: billing.dependency_unavailable
              retryable: true
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"

    AdmissionCaptureRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
        - run_id
        - call_id
        - attempt_id
        - evidence_schema_version
        - evidence_ref
        - evidence_event_id
        - evidence_revision
        - evidence_digest
      properties:
        run_id:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
        call_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        attempt_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        evidence_schema_version:
          type: string
          const: 2.0.0
        evidence_ref:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
        evidence_event_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        evidence_revision:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/PositiveDecimal"
        evidence_digest:
          type: string
          pattern: ^[0-9a-f]{64}$
    AdmissionReleaseRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
        - run_id
        - call_id
        - attempt_id
        - release_basis
        - evidence_schema_version
        - evidence_ref
        - evidence_event_id
        - evidence_revision
        - evidence_digest
        - reason
      properties:
        run_id:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
        call_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        attempt_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        release_basis:
          type: string
          enum:
            - not_dispatched
            - settled_remainder
        evidence_schema_version:
          type: string
          const: 2.0.0
        evidence_ref:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
        evidence_event_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        evidence_revision:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/PositiveDecimal"
        evidence_digest:
          type: string
          pattern: ^[0-9a-f]{64}$
        reason:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
